title: Sticky header, all-left alignment on screen, and plain-text Type values
permissions_required: Manager or Office User role (Reports section access) plus the Inventory Reports → View permission (S1-R4).
preconditions: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with enough rows to scroll the table body vertically.
steps: 1. Scroll the table body down and watch the header row.
3. Look at the alignment of every header label and cell, including numeric and money columns.
expected: 1. The header row is sticky - it stays visible while the body scrolls.
2. The Type column shows Inventory or Catalogue as plain text (no badge or chip styling).
3. ALL columns - header and cell data, including numbers and money - are left-aligned on screen. (The exports right-align numerics instead: a deliberate export-only difference, see PV-EXP-08.)
